2:
Hm? Nymph, what're you doing messing
around with a pile of sand?
3:
Hmph. I'm going to build a castle with all
this sand I gathered.
4:
A sandcastle? You sure know some weird
stuff~
5:
There was a scene like that in a daytime
soap.
6:
A man and a woman in love, building a
sandcastle together, all lovey-dovey...
7:
It gets really romantic~ Stuff like that
might be kinda nice.
8:
Is it, though...? It's basically just playing in
the sand, right?
9:
It's fine! Even if it's just playing in the
sand. In the drama, it was this super
detailed, gorgeous castle!
10: I'm planning to build one like that too.
12:
(She's working so hard with those tiny
hands...)
13:
H-hey, Tomoki. If you're just gonna watch
anyway, why don't we build it together?
15:
Well... I figured just watching would be
boring for you.
16:
I-if you say you don't want to, that's fine,
but...
17:
In the daytime soap, the two of them built
it together, so I thought it'd set the mood
better...
18:
B-besides, it'll get done faster if two
people build it!
19: (A sandcastle, huh... What should I do?)
23:
Fine. I'll build one too... Something way
cooler, right next to your castle, Nymph!
25:
Just watch! I'm gonna build a castle bigger
than yours!
26:
H-hey, wait! When I said build it together,
that's not what I meant...
27:
Why would you go out of your way to build
a separate castle?!
28:
Because the sand is there! Now let's get
started! Hyaaaaah!
30: First, I'm gonna gather up a ton of sand!
32:
Survival of the fittest! Hup! Hyah! It's
starting to take shape!
33:
What is that? It's not a castle, it's just a
tall pile of sand, isn't it?
34:
I mean, you've piled it way too high. It's
taller than you, Tomoki.
35:
With stuff like this, bigger is better!
Bigger!
36:
I dub it: the TOMO☆KI Lighthouse, towering
over the beach and guarding the peace of
the seas!
38:
Alriiight. It's getting to a nice height! I'm
gonna keep stacking it as high as it'll go!
41:
Gah... M-my TOMO☆KI Lighthouse... It's
falling...!
44:
I-it's heavy! I can't move! Did I stack it too
high?!
46:
What is this? What even is this... It's not
romantic at all...
47:
All I wanted was to build a castle with
Tomoki, like in the daytime soap...
48:
It's all ruined! Tomoki, you idiot! Stay buried
in the sand and think about what you did!
51:
Sure, I'll give you a hand. I've got nothing
better to do anyway.
53:
What? You're the one who invited me,
Nymph.
58:
Huh, just shaping it a little already makes
it look like the real thing. Alright, let's put
the front door here!
59:
The main gate, you mean. Let's give it about
three towers.
60:
Maybe we should put some windows on the
towers.
61:
Oh, how lovely. They're kind of in a weird
spot, though...
63: You don't need to decide stuff like that!
69:
Hmm. I guess this'll do. ...But it didn't get
very romantic, did it...
72:
Aw, my hands got all filthy. Nymph, let me
see your hands too.
75:
Your hands got dirty too, Nymph. We match!
Haha.
77:
Hey, Tomoki. ...It turned out a little
different from the daytime soap, but...
78: Building the sandcastle was really fun.
81: Hup. Nngh... Something like this, maybe?
82: Do this here... and make a hole...
84: Tomoki, is it really fun just watching?
86:
(I figured it'd crumble since it's just sand,
but...)
87:
(It's turning into a castle right before my
eyes, so I couldn't help staring.)
88:
Nah, it's actually pretty fun to watch.
You're really good with your hands, Nymph.
89: Huh?! Y-you're just joking anyway, right?
90:
What would be the point of joking about
something like this? Not that I care if you
believe me.
91:
You really think it's good? Is it wonderful?
Are you moved?!
92:
I didn't go that far! All I said was that it's
not bad!
93: Ehehe... I see. Not bad, huh...
94:
Umm, I really want to go all out here and
make an arch...
100:
...And just when things were getting
romantic with Tomoki...
102: Wh-why are you glaring at me?
103:
...She left. Happy one second, mad the
next. She sure keeps herself busy...
